messages:
Lina Park: Heads-up — I have a dentist appt tomorrow 12:00-13:20 PT and need someone to take primary for ~12:00-13:20 (I'm primary for the day 09:00-17:00). Also would like a secondary cover overlap 11:45-13:30 if possible. Sorry for the late ask. @rotation-bot can we do a quick swap flow?

rotation-bot: Current rota: Lina Park (primary 09:00-17:00), Devon H. (secondary 09:00-17:00). To propose a swap use `/oncall swap` or click https://rotations.redwood.ai/request?from=lina&date=2026-03-15. Note: please update PagerDuty after confirming.

Devon H.: I can take primary from 12:00-13:30 PT. I have a meeting at 13:30 that I can't move. Is 12:00-13:30 enough?

Lina Park: 12:00-13:30 would be great — covers the whole appointment window. Thanks! :relieved:

Marta G.: I can pick up secondary 11:45-13:45 PT to give extra overlap. I’ll be online/in Slack during that time.

Devon H.: Okay confirmed from me. Lina — want me to run the swap command or do you prefer to call it?

Lina Park: If you can run it that'd be amazing — I’ll verify PagerDuty after. Quick reminder: for any customer-impacting pages during that window follow the primary runbook and escalate to incident-bot if page persists >5 mins. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall-primary-handling

Devon H.: Running the swap now:
```
/oncall swap --from "Lina Park" --to "Devon H." --start "2026-03-15T12:00:00-07:00" --end "2026-03-15T13:30:00-07:00" --note "short primary cover for dentist appt"
```

rotation-bot: Swap accepted. Updated rota: Lina Park primary 09:00-12:00 & 13:30-17:00; Devon H. primary 12:00-13:30. Secondary updated: Marta G. 11:45-13:45. PagerDuty assignment groups updated.

incident-bot: Reminder — during swaps please confirm the on-call Slack status message and add a short note to the incident channel if there are any active alerts. If you see latency > 2x baseline, tag @platform-observability and run the quick triage checklist: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/triage/checklist

Lina Park: Confirmed — I updated my Slack status and left a note in #incidents: "brief swap 12:00-13:30 PT — Devon primary, Marta secondary". Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Devon H.: I’ll take the first 10 mins as warmup, will check the dashboards at 11:55 to ensure nothing is flaring. If anything looks off, I’ll page as usual.

Marta G.: I added a pinned comment in the swap request and set a calendar reminder. Good to go on my side.

Lina Park: Appreciate it. Leaving runbook pointers here for anyone stepping in: 1) primary runbook (PGP/SEV triage) https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/primary-sev 2) quick restart steps for inference pool (eng-runtime playbook) https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/runtime-restart 3) customer impact template https://confluence.redwood.ai/templates/customer-impact-note

Devon H.: All set. Ping me in-thread if you want me to stay a bit later.

rotation-bot: Automated note: Swap recorded at 2026-03-15T11:50:34Z by Devon H. (via /oncall).

Lina Park: Thanks again — I'll be reachable by SMS in case of urgent paging.

incident-bot: If anything escalates, run the containment checklist and set the incident channel topic to the active incident ID.

Marta G.: closing the loop — confirmed Slack presence and PagerDuty handoff, will monitor.

Devon H.: closing loop from my side too.
